title: Il percorso
note: The guided learning order. Every curriculum concept appears exactly once. Each concept becomes three steps (lesson, practice, challenge); each unit adds its games and a checkpoint.

sections.title: Livello B2: consolidare
sections.subtitle: Make the B2 grammar automatic and widen your everyday range.

units.title: Raccontare il passato
units.desc: Past tenses, the future of supposition and the words that go with them.

units.title: Pronomi senza paura
units.desc: Combined pronouns, ci and ne, where pronouns go, relative clauses.

units.title: Collegare le idee
units.desc: Verbs with prepositions, place and time, connectors, false friends.

units.title: Il congiuntivo
units.desc: Opinions, feelings, doubts and the conjunctions that need the subjunctive.

units.title: Se e ma
units.desc: Conditional, if-clauses and writing a proper formal email.

units.title: Costruzioni utili
units.desc: Passive, si, gerund, fare + infinitive, future in the past, word building.

sections.title: Verso il C1
sections.subtitle: Nuance, style and the structures that mark an advanced speaker.

units.title: Congiuntivo avanzato
units.desc: Relative clauses, indefinites, sequence of tenses, reported speech.

units.title: Sfumature
units.desc: Mixed conditionals, alternatives to se, pronominal verbs, implicit meaning.

units.title: Narrare
units.desc: Passato remoto, participles and infinitives in literary and spoken narrative.

units.title: Argomentare con stile
units.desc: Formal connectors, cleft sentences, nominal style, register, essays and debate.
